name: Waitwise
customer: Travelers and outdoor bookers who miss scarce appointment/release windows; secondary: builders researching appointment-access products
problem: Scarce appointment slots (passport, camping, visa) create repeated failed attempts; paid alert products and brittle scrapers exist, but trustworthy free prep + signal visibility is thin.
business_model: Free public guides + signal ledger now; later optional policy-compliant alerts (commerce OFF until OWNER Class 2 envelope + payment account).

brand.name: Waitwise
brand.positioning: Scarce appointment access — official paths, honest signals, no scrape.
brand.promise: Know the wait. Prep the path.
